summary: The evidence table, the rules and coverage document and the experiments page said that merge_guard merged seven merge requests with no click. Reading the notes of every merged merge request from the API shows nine: !35, !43, !40, !18, !47, !17, !16, !54 and !65, each with the notes marked ready and enabled an automatic merge. Of them, !65 only added the task files of a nested repair of a planted defect and its task was cancelled. The data file gains the two rows and the page tile follows.
